record.paper_title: Erdős-Macintyre type theorem’s for multiple Dirichlet series: exceptional sets and open problems
record.original_question: Let p≥1 and let F∈D_p(λ^p) be an entire function on C^p represented by an absolutely convergent multiple Dirichlet series F(z)=∑_{n∈Z_+^p} a_n exp(<z,λ_n>), where λ_n=(λ^{(1)}_{n1},...,λ^{(p)}_{np}) and each coordinate exponent sequence tends to +∞. For x∈R^p define M(x,F)=sup{|F(x+iy)|: y∈R^p}, m(x,F)=inf{|F(x+iy)|: y∈R^p}, and μ(x,F)=max{|a_n|exp(<x,λ_n>) : n∈Z_+^p}. Under the coordinate gap conditions ∑_{k=0}∞ 1/(λ^{(j)}_{k+1}-λ^{(j)}_k)<∞ for every j=1,...,p, is finiteness of τ_p(E)=∫_{E∖B_p(1)} dx_1...dx_p/|x|^(p−1) the best possible size description for exceptional sets E outside which M(x,F)=(1+o(1))μ(x,F) and M(x,F)=(1+o(1))m(x,F) hold as |x|→∞?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let p ≥ 1 be an integer. For each j = 1, ..., p, let (λ^{(j)}_k)_{k≥0} be a strictly increasing sequence of nonnegative real numbers with λ^{(j)}_k → +∞ as k → ∞, satisfying the gap condition
   ∑_{k=0}^{∞} 1/(λ^{(j)}_{k+1} − λ^{(j)}_k) < ∞.
For n = (n_1, ..., n_p) ∈ Z_+^p set λ_n = (λ^{(1)}_{n_1}, ..., λ^{(p)}_{n_p}). Let F : C^p → C be an entire function represented by an absolutely convergent multiple Dirichlet series
   F(z) = ∑_{n ∈ Z_+^p} a_n exp(⟨z, λ_n⟩),  z ∈ C^p,
where ⟨·,·⟩ denotes the standard real inner product. For x ∈ R^p define
   M(x, F) = sup{|F(x + iy)| : y ∈ R^p},
   m(x, F) = inf{|F(x + iy)| : y ∈ R^p},
   μ(x, F) = max{|a_n| exp(⟨x, λ_n⟩) : n ∈ Z_+^p}.
For a measurable set E ⊂ R^p let B_p(1) be the closed unit ball and define
   τ_p(E) = ∫_{E ∖ B_p(1)} dx_1 ⋯ dx_p / |x|^{p−1}.
Question: Is it true that τ_p is the sharpest size characterization of exceptional sets in the following sense — namely, that for every such F there exists E ⊂ R^p with τ_p(E) < ∞ such that
   M(x, F) = (1 + o(1)) μ(x, F)  and  M(x, F) = (1 + o(1)) m(x, F)
hold as |x| → ∞, x ∉ E, and that this finiteness condition on τ_p(E) cannot be replaced by any strictly stronger smallness condition?
artifact.category_tag: Multiple Dirichlet series and exceptional sets
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that τ_p provides the best possible size description for the exceptional sets in the Erdős–Macintyre type relations for entire multiple Dirichlet series has been shown to be false. A direct search for the specific conjecture did not return independent confirmation online, but the source itself records that "Conjecture 1 is false," so the proposed sharpness statement does not hold.
